plugin-data.name: Static Cache
plugin-data.description: Caches rendered pages to disk and serves them on subsequent anonymous requests. The cache is cleared automatically when content or settings change.

clear-cache-tip: Removes all cached files. They will be regenerated on the next anonymous visit.
how-it-works: Anonymous GET requests are served from disk on cache hit. Edits, deletes and settings changes clear the cache; the next visitor refills it. Logged-in users, POST requests and URLs with query strings bypass the cache.
